testcase.name: Scenario: Filter out a selected recent part: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:262:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Filter out a selected recent part ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And recent parts and assemblies are displayed in List View ✔ And one part row is checked and no other rows are checked ✔ And no recent-document filters are active ✔ When the user opens Filter and selects Assembly ✔ Then assembly rows are displayed and the selected part is not displayed ✔ And Open Selected and Remove Selected are no longer displayed ✔ When the user clears the active filter ✔ Then the part row is displayed again without a checkmark ✔ And Open Selected and Remove Selected remain absent
